title: The Unfinished Architecture
text:
Postmodern fiction often refuses to offer a stable narrator or a single authoritative truth. Instead, it foregrounds its own artifice, inviting readers to notice the seams where story and structure meet. In a typical experimental novel, a footnote may contradict the main narrative, and a chapter may end mid-sentence. Such techniques are designed to unsettle the expectation that a text will resolve into meaning.

Critics have debated whether this approach is a genuine challenge to convention or merely a fashionable pose. Defenders argue that fragmentation reflects the fractured experience of modern life, while skeptics contend that it can alienate readers without deepening their understanding. Both camps, however, agree that the reader is no longer a passive recipient but an active participant in assembling the work.

questions.text: According to the first paragraph, what does postmodern fiction often refuse to offer?
options: A stable narrator or a single authoritative truth
A detailed description of the setting
A list of characters at the start

questions.text: According to the second paragraph, what do defenders of fragmentation argue?
options: It reflects the fractured experience of modern life
It makes books shorter and easier to read
It is a traditional way of telling stories
It has no effect on readers at all

questions.text: What can be inferred about the author's attitude toward experimental techniques?
options: The author treats them as a serious subject of debate rather than dismissing them
The author believes they should be abandoned entirely
The author thinks they are useful only for children's books
The author is indifferent to whether readers understand them

questions.text: Why might a chapter ending mid-sentence be considered a deliberate challenge to readers?
options: It refuses the expectation that a text will resolve into a clear meaning
It shows the author ran out of time to finish
It makes the book cheaper to print

vocabulary.definition: a clever or artificial construction, used to create an effect
places something in a prominent position so it is noticed
to make someone feel uneasy or disturb a settled expectation
the breaking of something into separate, disconnected pieces

paragraph_translations: Postmodern kurgu, çoğu zaman istikrarlı bir anlatıcı ya da tek bir yetkili gerçeği sunmayı reddeder. Bunun yerine kendi yapaylığını öne çıkarır ve okuyucuyu hikâyenin ve yapının birleştiği dikişleri fark etmeye davet eder. Tipik bir deneysel romanda bir dipnot ana anlatıyla çelişebilir ve bir bölüm yarım cümleyle bitebilir. Bu tür teknikler, bir metnin sonunda anlama dönüşeceği beklentisini sarsmak için tasarlanmıştır.

Eleştirmenler bu yaklaşımın geleneğe gerçek bir meydan okuma mı yoksa yalnızca moda bir duruş mu olduğunu tartışmaktadır. Savunucular parçalanmanın modern yaşamın kırık deneyimini yansıttığını savunurken, şüpheciler bunun okuyucuyu anlayışını derinleştirmeden yabancılaştırabileceğini ileri sürmektedir. Yine de her iki kesim, okuyucunun artık pasif bir alıcı değil, eseri bir araya getirmede etkin bir katılımcı olduğu konusunda hemfikirdir.
